messages.content: 你能提供關於電影《全面啟動》的簡介，然後再幫我檢索有關同一部電影《全面啟動》的導演、演員、獎項等額外訊息，以及電影《黑暗騎士》的導演、演員、獎項等額外訊息嗎？

function.name: movie_details_brief
function.description: This function retrieves a brief about a specified movie. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

extra_info.description: Option to get additional information like Director, Cast, Awards etc.

message.reasoning:
The user wants:

1) Brief summary of film 《全面啟動》 (Inception). 
2) Then retrieve extra info such as director, cast, awards for Inception and also same for The Dark Knight.

We have tool `movie_details_brief` which can fetch details given title and optional extra_info flag. We need two calls? Actually we could call twice with different titles or maybe one per request. But the tool only accepts single title; but we might do separate calls for each movie. For Inception we want both brief and extra info. So either set extra_info true returns full details including director/cast/awards? It says option to get additional info like Director, Cast, Awards etc. So if we pass extra_info=true it will return those fields. That covers all needed. So just call once for Inception with extra_info:true. And again for The Dark Knight with extra_info:true. Provide results accordingly.

Thus produce JSON output from tool calls. Use correct format. Let's craft calls.

First call:
{
"title":"Inception",
"extra_info":true
}

Second call:
{
"title":"The Dark Knight",
"extra_info":true
}

Return them sequentially.
